scripts.build: pnpm messages && pnpm --filter @livtales/api-client build && next build
scripts.dev: pnpm messages && pnpm --filter @livtales/api-client build && next dev
scripts.sandbox: pnpm messages && pnpm --filter @livtales/api-client build && node sandbox/build.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm messages && pnpm --filter @livtales/api-client build && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm messages && pnpm --filter @livtales/api-client build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
